1.content:
## Kong Konnect Audit Logs
Security audit monitoring across **access**, **authorization**, and **authentication** events streamed from Kong Konnect.

11.query:
fetch logs
| filter log.source == "kong-audit-webhook" and konnect_format == "authorization"
| summarize cnt = count(), by:{audit.result}
| sort audit.result desc
11.title: Granted vs Denied

12.query:
fetch logs
| filter log.source == "kong-audit-webhook" and konnect_format == "authorization"
| summarize cnt = count(), by:{audit.action, audit.result}
| sort cnt desc
| limit 15
12.title: Authorization by Resource

14.query:
fetch logs
| filter log.source == "kong-audit-webhook" and konnect_format == "access"
| summarize cnt = count(), by:{audit.action}
| sort cnt desc
| limit 15
14.title: Top API Actions

15.query:
fetch logs
| filter log.source == "kong-audit-webhook"
| summarize cnt = count(), by:{client.ip}
| sort cnt desc
| limit 10
15.title: Top Source IPs

16.query:
fetch logs
| filter log.source == "kong-audit-webhook"
| summarize cnt = count(), by:{audit.identity}
| sort cnt desc
| limit 10
16.title: Activity by Principal

17.query:
fetch logs
| filter log.source == "kong-audit-webhook"
| fields timestamp, konnect_format, audit.identity, audit.action, audit.result, client.ip, result.code
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 100
17.title: Recent Audit Events

18.query:
fetch logs
| filter log.source == "kong-audit-webhook" and konnect_format == "authentication" and audit.result == "Failed"
| summarize cnt = count(), by:{audit.action}
| sort cnt desc
18.title: Auth Failures by Method

19.query:
fetch logs
| filter log.source == "kong-audit-webhook" and konnect_format == "authorization" and audit.result == "Failed"
| summarize cnt = count(), by:{audit.action, audit.identity}
| sort cnt desc
| limit 15
19.title: Authorization Denials

2.query:
fetch logs
| filter log.source == "kong-audit-webhook"
| summarize total = count()
2.title: Total Events

20.query:
fetch logs
| filter log.source == "kong-audit-webhook" and konnect_format == "access"
| summarize cnt = count(), by:{result.code}
| sort cnt desc
20.title: HTTP Status Codes

3.query:

3.title: Access Events

4.title: Authorization Events
